maturity_slice: Adoption Identity Persistence and OrgID Migration

acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Adopted runtime identity fingerprints persist per org/service/environment.
AC2 OrgID migration preserves tenant boundaries.
AC3 Adoption metadata is available to desired-state planning.

rollout_gates.gate: Fingerprint uniqueness checks pass for migrated rows.
Adoption import does not cross org boundaries.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Restore from pre-migration backup if org-boundary checks fail.
